bagPolicy.summary: The FSU Athletics policy permits one clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bag up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches or a one-gallon clear resealable bag, plus a clutch up to 4.5 × 6.5 inches. The published scope is FSU Athletics events; concert rules should be checked with the organizer.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: For football games, parking lots open five hours before kickoff or by noon. Reserved ADA parking is on level 1 of the Pensacola Street Garage through the Disabled Parking Program, with a free shuttle to Gates E and J starting 2 hours before kickoff. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Doak Campbell Stadium. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: FSU’s stadium football FAQ states alcoholic drinks are sold at concession stands. Concert availability and prices may differ.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The football FAQ gives stadium accessibility guidance for athletics events; accessible concert seating and entry should be checked for the specific show.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: For football games, you can't leave and re-enter once inside the gates, except during a weather delay. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.

ticketPickup.summary: Will call tickets can be picked up at the FSU Athletics Ticket Office, next to Gate B, 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Monday to Friday, with photo ID; only the ticket holder can pick up unless arranged in advance. For football games, game-day will call is at the Dick Howser Ticket Office across from Gate K. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.

gates.summary: For football games, all gates open two hours before kickoff. Varsity Club seatholders enter through the Moore Building loading ramp near Gate A, and Champions Club and other premium ticket holders use the entrance across from Langford Green. Concerts set their own times, so check your event page.
